Review mysite.ai?

mysite.ai earns praise for its clean, fast, and intuitive flow that gets a responsive site live in minutes, making it handy for small businesses and quick landing pages. Reviewers highlight thoughtful design choices and smooth onboarding, noting it’s already useful despite being early. Constructive feedback centers on customization depth, occasional instruction mismatches, and the crowded AI-builder landscape; some users struggled with image handling and terminology. Overall, sentiment is strongly positive: clear value, low friction, and promising potential—if the team sharpens editing controls and carves a sharper differentiator.

results.title: Polish startup mysite.ai secures €2.1M pre-seed round led by Inovo.vc | Vestbee
results.content:
mysite.ai was founded in 2022 by Patryk Pijanowski and Sebastian Kurzynowski. The company develops tools that automate the conversion of design files into production-ready frontend code.
 Its platform, Codejet, integrates a design system within Figma, enabling users to assemble websites from responsive components and generate clean, production-quality code via a plugin.
 The firm also provides an AI assistant that manages the online presence of micro-businesses. The core feature is an AI website agent that creates, writes, and publishes custom websites based on user input, requiring no coding or design skills.
